messages.subject: Sutherland Logistics / Vantage Freight Solutions - response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We now act for Vantage Freight Solutions Limited. Our formal response to your letter before action of 18 August 2025 will follow under separate cover today, but in short liability is denied in full. Our client's position is that it was entitled to withhold payment and to terminate by reason of your client's service failures from late 2024.

We will of course set out our client's full case in any Defence.

Yours faithfully,
Martin Greaves
Marlowe Greaves LLP
Your ref: SAW/WC-00115 | Our ref: MG/VFS/0042

messages.subject: RE: Sutherland Logistics / Vantage Freight Solutions - response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Greaves,

Thank you. We note that liability is denied but that no particulars of the alleged service failures are given, and that no breach notice was ever served under clause 13.1. Your client's reliance on a termination "for convenience" is, with respect, untenable on the face of clause 13.1.

Unless the unpaid invoices of £487,250 are paid within 14 days our client will issue proceedings without further notice.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
